content: In men with diabetes who exhibit symptoms of hypogonadism, testosterone replacement therapy can potentially enhance sexual function, improve mood, and increase muscle strength. To ensure accurate assessment of testosterone levels, it is recommended to perform serum testosterone tests in the morning, as testosterone levels naturally fluctuate throughout the day due to diurnal variation. The measurement of testosterone levels may involve advanced techniques such as equilibrium dialysis or calculations derived from total testosterone levels in conjunction with specific hormone-binding proteins.
